arguments.text: Independent translation check: F consists of every subset of {1,2,3} and the extra top {1,2,3,4}. It is union-closed, has N=9 distinct members and frequencies (5,5,5,1)/9. Ordered union multiplicities are 1,3,3,9,3,9,9,27,17 in mask order [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,15]. Actions 17 and 18 certify the entropy of the minimizer of sum P log(P/K_theta), K_theta(A,B)=r(A union B)^(-theta), with uniform marginals. H_4>=107/50=2.14 nats and H_8<=53/25=2.12 nats disprove monotonicity in theta. This is a counterexample to our auxiliary universal monotonicity hypothesis, not Frankl, not Jiang Theorem 10.2, and not a monotonicity assertion restricted to frequencies at most 1/2.

arguments.text: Written general-family lemma, not formally verified and no novelty claim. Let F_k=2^[k] plus T=[k+1], k>=3, N=2^k+1, U=[k]. Then r(S)=3^|S| for S subset [k], and r(T)=2N-1. For any permutation, a cycle contained in the cube has union-cost sum at least its diagonal cost, with equality only for fixed points. A nontrivial cycle T,A1,...,Am,T has excess cost log(2N-1)-|A1|log3+sum_{i<m}|Ai minus A(i+1)|log3, at least log(2N-1)-k log3, with equality only for m=1,A1=U. Since 3^k>2N-1 for k>=3, the unique minimum-cost permutation exchanges U and T and fixes everything else. By the Birkhoff decomposition this is the unique linear-cost minimizer among uniform-marginal couplings. For P_theta, comparison with that minimizer bounds the excess linear cost by log(N)/theta; compactness and uniqueness imply convergence to it. Thus the limiting union law has count 0 at U, 2 at T, and 1 elsewhere out of N, with entropy log N-(2/N)log2. Maximum frequency is (N+1)/(2N); writing delta=pmax-1/2 gives limiting entropy deficit 4*delta*log2. This supplies a necessary boundary consistency check for a future gap-sensitive theorem; it does not establish such a theorem.
